title: PSU Banks Made ₹1.10L Cr Profit — Why Are the Stocks Still Flat? #Shorts
description:
PSU banks posted their best-ever profit in H1 FY27 — ₹1.10 lakh crore across all 12 public sector banks. NPAs hit a historic low. So why are SBI, PNB and Bank of Baroda stocks still flat while private banks have given 2-3x returns?

This reel breaks down the contradiction: record profits, clean books, but the market still doesn't re-rate PSU banks.
